text:
Reference table showing the total soil nitrate-N (as available N) needed in the soil to support different corn grain yield targets:

- Target yield 1 t/ha: 32 kg N/ha required
- Target yield 2 t/ha: 64 kg N/ha required
- Target yield 3 t/ha: 96 kg N/ha required
- Target yield 4 t/ha: 128 kg N/ha required

This works out to a simple rule of thumb of about 32 kg of available nitrogen needed per tonne of target grain yield, which can be used alongside a soil nitrate test (see the nitrogen soil-test calculation topic) or the soil-nitrate urea decision table to plan fertilizer nitrogen rates.
